name: Check if immutable releases are enabled for a repository
description: Check if immutable releases are enabled for a repository Shows whether immutable releases are enabled or disabled. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/immutable-releases
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/immutable-releases
Shows whether immutable releases are enabled or disabled. Also identifies whether immutability is being enforced by the repository owner. The authenticated user must have admin read access to the repository.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

name: Disable immutable releases
description: Disable immutable releases Disables immutable releases for a repository. DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/immutable-releases
context:
DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/immutable-releases
Disables immutable releases for a repository. The authenticated user must have admin access to the repository.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
